name: An Uneasy Truce
objective: Sigrun returns — not to fight, but to warn. The Echo Cult has all five remaining Frostbells, and they intend to ring them at the solstice.
intro: She finds you at the Pokémon Center, arms crossed, watching the door. She sits with her back to the wall.
dialogue: Hunter Sigrun: "The cult isn't Krampus. Krampus wanted power. These people think they're saving the world."
Hunter Sigrun: "That makes them worse. People who think they're merciful don't stop. Find their chapel."
lore_discovery: Sigrun gives the player a sketch of the cult's chapel in the hills and, grudgingly, a warning: the Herald is real, and she has seen it.
